narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive record of the implemented Lab04 simulation surface, not a new visual direction. The binding instruction is: “Treat final-project-reference.png as the primary visual source of truth”. Ice-blue surfaces, compact instrument controls and an editable electrical schematic reproduce that supplied workspace while retaining the real application's identity and results.

The system is code-led: Flask/Jinja, native form controls, vanilla JavaScript and SVG. The source comp is read-only evidence, never a rendered background. Qualitative language here describes the artifact under the delegated brief; no new visual-world interview or creative approval is implied.
keyCharacteristics: Ice-blue tonal layering and teal actions.
Electrical color semantics, not decorative chart colors.
Real, independently retained analyses with explicit freshness.

rules.name: The Electrical Meaning Rule
rules.body: Preserve color roles and accompanying labels, line styles and statuses; a green solver result does not mean instructor approval.

rules.name: The Solver Truth Rule
rules.body: Validate reports finite/current input and solver checks only. Keep “Simulation ≠ instructor validation”, unverified external-model provenance and Not run benchmark/instructor states truthful.

dos: **Do** preserve Lab04 identity and the supplied comp's laboratory visual hierarchy.
**Do** preserve electrical colors, units, editable SVG and real solver provenance.
**Do** retain analytical Lab03 links and clearly distinguish model-controlled fields.
**Do** apply responsive rules through the scoped final cascade, not whole-page scaling.
donts: **Don't** use the reference screenshot as a UI background or generate replacement imagery.
**Don't** fabricate results, instructor approval, benchmark passes or unsupported circuit features.
**Don't** treat reference-specific tiny labels as a universal legibility standard.
**Don't** spread compact simulation overrides into analytical pages without checking their existing styles.
